entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: A green-white guild of Ravnica, a decentralized nature collective founded by Mat'Selesnya, with Vitu-Ghazi as its guildhall.

entities.name: Mat'Selesnya
entities.description: The female elemental parun, formed from fused dryads, who founded the Conclave and now rests dormant within Vitu-Ghazi.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: A fusion of three dryad sisters (Harmony, Order, Life) who serves as Mat'Selesnya's voice and guildmaster.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: The dryad of life, an aspect of Trostani, who commits murders with mind-controlling spores.

entities.name: Emmara Tandris
entities.description: A Selesnya leader and friend of Jace Beleren who runs the guild's daily affairs and advocates peace among guilds.

entities.name: Suniel
entities.description: A figure who helped three dryad sisters fuse into Trostani.

entities.name: Garo
entities.description: A glade-master revealed to be in league with Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The dragon whose victory would end all life, and with whom Garo was in league.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker and Living Guildpact, friend of Emmara.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who sought Selesnya's help to revive Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Teyo
entities.description: A member of the party that sought Selesnya's cooperation.

entities.name: Rat
entities.description: A member of the party that sought Selesnya's cooperation.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: A dragon the party sought to revive.

entities.name: Wrizfar Barkfeather
entities.description: An elven shapeshifter who headed Selesnya in Utvara.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The towering world tree that serves as the guild's guildhall, partly destroyed in the War of the Spark and later replanted.

entities.name: Vitar Yescu
entities.description: An enormous living tree in Utvara whose pollen acted as an antibody to the local plague.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane where the guild is located.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: A guild whose interpretation of law trumps the Conclave's.

entities.name: Ledev Guardians
entities.description: The defenders of the Selesnya.

entities.name: Knight Order of Mat'selesnya
entities.description: A half-military order founded after the Decamillennial.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The battle during which the God-Eternals partially destroyed Vitu-Ghazi.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion in which the Selesnya fought to defend Ravnica.

events.summary: After the Decamillennial the Selesnya lose their connection to the World Tree and rely on a high council; Mat'Selesnya goes dormant within Vitu-Ghazi and Suniel helps three dryads fuse into Trostani.
events.quote: Suniel helped three Dryad sisters to fuse into Trostani to function as the direct voice of Mat'Selesnya and as the new guildmaster.

events.summary: The Selesnya are lynched en masse during the events of Agents of Artifice for their role in oppressing the guilds, but later return.
events.quote: the Selesnya were lynched en masse due to the citizens realizing their role in forcing the oppression of the guilds.

events.summary: Before the War of the Spark Trostani's three heads fall into discord, and Emmara steps forward after Garo is revealed to be in league with Bolas.
events.quote: Emmara Tandris stepped forward to fill the void in leadership, after glade-master Garo was revealed to be in league with Nicol Bolas .

events.summary: Kaya, Teyo and Rat ask Selesnya's help to revive Niv-Mizzet; Emmara declines but Harmony wakes and commits Selesnya to the alliance against Bolas.
events.quote: Harmony, the middle Trostani, finally woke up and decided that Selesnya would be joining the other guilds to defeat Bolas.

events.summary: Oba becomes the primary aspect of Trostani and lends strength to Vitu-Ghazi after its damage in the War of the Spark and the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Oba, the dryad of life, became the primary aspect of Trostani, lending her strength to the tree

events.summary: After the Invasion the Conclave closes in on itself and refuses all aid and offers to help others.
events.quote: Immediately following the end of the Invasion, the Conclave closed in on itself, shutting itself off to outsiders.

events.summary: Trostani commits a series of murders of prominent Ravnicans with mind-controlling spores; Oba is subdued by her sisters and control returns to Emmara.
events.quote: After Oba was subdued by her sisters, Trostani stepped back to confer with Mat'Selesnya, returning control of the guild to Emmara Tandris.

relations.quote: Founded by parun Mat'Selesnya , a female humanoid elemental formed via the fusion of dryads
to function as the direct voice of Mat'Selesnya and as the new guildmaster.
As a friend of Jace Beleren, she understood that he was never going to be able to settle on Ravnica
glade-master Garo was revealed to be in league with Nicol Bolas .

relations.note: The dryad of life is one of Trostani's aspects.
relations.quote: Oba, the dryad of life, became the primary aspect of Trostani
